scope: Checkpoint B metadata only; X3 expression-bearing RDS not acquired because a qualified metadata-only runtime and sufficient memory are not established; X5 only Table S1 and FAQ/source metadata.

retained_X3_design.weighting: equal reported sample weights, not cells or lanes
retained_X3_design.support: all three samples per compared day have nonempty nominated author state; otherwise show available samples but hold group expression contrast
retained_X3_design.zero_state: zero composition if a verified state is absent; expression undefined; missing metadata never interpreted as zero

X5_screen: Source-level metadata only: flag lung/peripheral-blood and healthy labels, never infer their sample-level joint distribution; no gene query.
X5_zero_rule: FAQ states unmeasured genes are encoded as zero; must recover dataset-by-gene measurement mask before expression interpretation.
